name: bento
description: Bento: carb, fluid and sodium fueling planner for rides, runs and trail runs (React + TypeScript, static)

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && mkdir -p coverage && node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include='site/src/lib/**' --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=coverage/lcov.info 'tests/**/*.test.ts'
